concerns.text: FR-002 (≥95% record retention) and SC-003 lack a dedicated verification task. T011 is marked [X] but the analyze report indicates it is syntactically invalid and depends on missing schema. A specific task to assert SC-003 in `test_preprocess.py` is missing or broken.

FR-004 (fit distributions) and SC-001 (KS test/AIC) lack a verified implementation task. T023 (schema validation) and T018 (contract test) are marked [ ] (unimplemented) or failed in the analyze report, leaving no task to verify the core statistical engine against the spec.

Edge Case (n < 100) for Anderson-Darling test is unimplemented. T021 is marked [ ] (unimplemented), leaving the system unable to handle the specified edge case for small sample sizes as required by the spec.

FR-012 (checkpoint mechanism) and Constitution Principle V (hashing) are at risk. T015 (checkpoint integration) is marked [ ] (unimplemented), and T007 (hashing) depends on missing config. No task explicitly verifies the checkpoint resumption logic for the 6-hour limit.

FR-006 (mixed-effects model) and FR-011 (VIF) are unverified. T027 depends on T014 (lagged pressure) and T006b (metadata), but the failure of T013b (anonymization) and T015 (checkpointing) in Phase 3 breaks the data pipeline required for T027 to execute or be verified.

FR-008 (Bonferroni correction) and SC-004 (error rate control) rely on T038, which aggregates p-values from T020 and T027. Since upstream tasks (T020, T027) depend on rejected/unverified sub-tasks (T021, T023), the global correction cannot be calculated or verified.

T010 (contract test for US1) contains a syntax error (`self.asser`) and depends on a missing `run_record.schema.yaml` (T004). This creates a circular dependency where the test cannot run to verify the schema, violating the testability requirement for SC-003.

T006b (load game metadata) and FR-006 (external difficulty labels) are at risk because T013b (anonymization) failed due to a missing `config.yaml`. If the configuration file is missing, T006 (config creation) may not have been completed, blocking the retrieval of external difficulty labels.
